# Catch restore storage warnings before they regress

## What & Why
The restore flow needs browser-level coverage for quota or unavailable-storage failures, not just unit coverage of the write helper. A regression test should protect both halves of the user promise: restored data stays visible in memory and the success message is replaced with a warning that it was not persisted.

## Done looks like
- A Playwright test makes localStorage writes throw while importing a valid workspace backup.
- The test confirms the warning explains the persistence failure.
- The test confirms restored profile, answer, and opportunity details remain visible before reload.

## Relevant files
- artifacts/escape-hatch/tests/persistence.spec.ts
- artifacts/escape-hatch/src/App.tsx
